summary: Fail module linking when a named import or reexport cannot resolve the requested export.

target.notes: Fail during linking/instantiation before the importing module body executes.

caveats: Do not degrade missing exports to null/missing-property reads.

tests.name: missing import prevents body
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export const x=1
// main.mjs: import {y} from './a.mjs'; console.log('body');
tests.expected_behavior: linking fails and body does not print

tests.name: missing reexport fails link
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export const x=1
// mid.mjs: export {y} from './a.mjs'
tests.expected_behavior: module linking fails because y cannot resolve
